an3.2:1.1: This reads like an adage, but is not attested elsewhere. | _Apadānasobhanī paññā_ is obscure and there are variants. In the Suttas, _apadāna_ means “evidence”, “trace left behind”, originally from the sense “cuttings” of grass ([dn27:16.4](), [dn24:2.7.3](), [mn15:3.32](), [an3.2:1.1](), [an11.14:2.3]()). The idea is that wisdom is not just a mental quality, but can be discerned in a person’s conduct, an idea followed up in the next Sutta.
